INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
